deadline.value: International applicants apply by 1 February for Fall entry.

gre_subject.value: Not stated on the page checked

supervisor.value: Supervisor's name required AT APPLICATION; you must be accepted by a thesis supervisor to register
supervisor.quote: Identify at least one professor who is willing to supervise your research and thesis. We recommend that you contact potential thesis supervisors as soon as possible. To register, you need to have been accepted by a thesis supervisor. The supervisor’s name is required at the time of application.

funding.value: Doctoral admits (including international) with an admission average of 8.0/10 (A-) or higher get an admission scholarship of at least CA$72,000 over four years; others rely on supervisor or other funding. International students must also show proof of funding (supervisor stipend plus awards or trust funds).
funding.quote: Have an admission average of 8.0/10 or higher. | This financial support offers a minimum value of $72,000 over a period of four (4) years

also.quote: Note: International students must provide proof of financial support: i.e., a stipend provided by a supervisor as well as a combination of awards and/or trust funds.

entry_route.value: Master's in physics (or equivalent) with 75% (B+); MSc fast-track to PhD possible
entry_route.quote: Be the holder of a master’s degree in physics (or equivalent) with a minimum average of 75% (B+).

notes: Joint uOttawa-Carleton institute; your supervisor's home university awards the degree.
